citation.authors: Hibbs SP, Jones J, Hantel A, Merz LE

cited_by.title: A low white cell count that may be Duffy-null (neutrophil count)

record.design: Review of Duffy antigen testing, epidemiology, neutrophil counts and clinical consequences
record.finding: The Duffy null variant is a non-pathological mutation that is partly protective against Plasmodium vivax and gives a lower neutrophil count without increasing infection risk. In many regions neutropenia has been defined by the counts of Duffy-positive people, which may be unsuitable for decisions in Duffy-null people.
